cards.prompt: Dalam aturan 7-38-55, siapa yang menciptakan aturan ini?
Urutkan komponen pesan dari kontribusi terkecil ke terbesar menurut aturan 7-38-55.
In the 7-38-55 rule, body gestures account for ____ of the perceived message.
Someone says 'I'm totally fine' but avoids eye contact and sounds tense. What does the rule suggest?
options: Believe the words, they are the main message
The words and body language don't align; they may be unconvinced
cards.answer: The words and body language don't align, so they may be lying or unconvinced.
